tools.name: team_create
tools.description: Create an agent team that you (the lead) run: teammates are Claude Code, OpenAI Codex or Google Antigravity agents working in the background. Limits come from the developer; you can only lower them. Next: task_create, team_spawn, then team_wait.

cwd.description: Absolute project folder (default: this server's folder).

limits.description: Optional lower limits: max_teammates, max_turns_per_teammate, max_total_turns, deadline_minutes, result_cap_chars.

self_claim.description: Idle teammates take the next available task themselves (default true).

tools.name: team_spawn
tools.description: Start a teammate in the background (returns at once). Pick the agent and tier per role: light for scouting, balanced for routine work, deep for security/architecture. Teammates are read-only unless can_edit is true; editing teammates work in their own git worktree by default. Give a `task` (text) or `task_id`, or let it self-claim from the task list.

team.description: Team name (default: the team used last).

role.description: Role instructions: what this teammate focuses on and how.

model.description: Optional model override for that agent.

can_edit.description: Allow file edits (default false). Editing Antigravity teammates always use a worktree (agy has no edit-only mode).

isolation.description: For editing teammates: own git worktree (default in a git repo) or the shared project folder.

owns.description: Files or folders (from the repo root) this teammate may change; others are flagged.

task.description: Initial task text (creates a task assigned to this teammate).

task_id.description: Assign an existing pending task instead.

max_turns.description: Lower turn limit for this teammate.

tools.name: task_create
tools.description: Add tasks to the team task list. A task with depends_on starts only after those tasks complete; cycles are refused. Optional `check` is a command (argv array, no shell, e.g. ["npm","test"]) that must pass before "done" counts; it runs without asking, so it only works when the developer set H0WZY_TEAM_ALLOW_CHECKS=1.

team.description: Team name (default: the team used last).

assignee.description: Teammate name (optional; unassigned tasks are self-claimed).

tools.name: task_update
tools.description: Change a task as the lead: reassign, cancel, reopen (pending), or mark completed/failed. Reassigning a running task applies after the current turn.

team.description: Team name (default: the team used last).

tools.name: task_list
tools.description: Show the team task list, one line per task.

team.description: Team name (default: the team used last).

tools.name: team_status
tools.description: Full picture in one call: each teammate (state, agent/model, task, turns, cost, unread messages), team limits and the task list. Prefer team_wait to follow progress; use this when you need everything at once. Also loads a saved team by name.

team.description: Team name (default: the team used last).

cwd.description: Project folder of a saved team, if two saved teams share its name.

tools.name: team_wait
tools.description: Wait for the next team event (a teammate finished or failed, a task completed, a message to you, a limit hit) and return every event you have not seen. Returns as soon as something happens; call it again to keep following. Results are compact; read full outputs with team_result.

team.description: Team name (default: the team used last).

tools.name: team_message
tools.description: Send a message to a teammate. It arrives at the start of its next turn; an idle teammate wakes for one turn (within its budget).

team.description: Team name (default: the team used last).

tools.name: team_result
tools.description: Read the full saved output of a teammate turn or change set by its ref (e.g. "reviewer#2"), page by page.

team.description: Team name (default: the team used last).

tools.name: team_changes
tools.description: Show the change set of a teammate that edits in its own git worktree (status, diff stat, full diff ref). remove: true deletes the worktree afterwards.

team.description: Team name (default: the team used last).

tools.name: team_shutdown
tools.description: Stop one teammate or the whole team. A running turn gets a grace period (default 60 s), then is stopped. Worktrees are kept.

team.description: Team name (default: the team used last).
